headline: WEC Energy Group (WEC) Could Be 12% Below Fair Value After Fresh Guidance
summary: Why WEC Energy Group stock is in focus after new guidance WEC Energy Group (WEC) is back on investors’ radar after releasing second quarter 2026 results and updating guidance for the upcoming quarter, including a reaffirmation of its full year earnings outlook. The company reported second quarter sales of US$2,062.1 million and net income of US$299.2 million, alongside updated earnings forecasts that give shareholders a fresh reference point for assessing the stock against its recent price...
